tone_frequency.title: Tonal interference · frequency sweep
tone_frequency.description: Rear tone swept from 20–40 kHz in 125 Hz steps. Each point averages nine target/interferer levels (−20 to +20 dB), two target directions and three seeds: 54 cases per frequency. Target is 20–40 kHz broadband at −36 dBFS RMS; independent noise −46 dBFS. Rear source [0.15, 0, −0.30] m; other conditions fixed.

tone_sir.title: Tonal interference · strength sweep
tone_sir.description: The same swept-tone cases regrouped by strength. Each point averages all 161 interferer frequencies, two target directions and three seeds. This is a second view of the same tests, not an extra contribution to the score.

broadband.title: Broadband rear-interference check
broadband.description: Synthetic coherent point interferer at [0.15, 0, −0.30] m, behind the array, with spherical delays and 1/r level differences. Target −36 dBFS RMS, noise −46 dBFS. Interferer level is referenced to RMS on the native 30-mic array. This is an in-band drone interference stress proxy, not recorded propeller noise. Two target directions × three seeds.

scoring: Rear-interference score: 50% existing broadband check + 50% uniformly frequency-weighted tonal sweep. The strength projection is not counted again. Other seven radar categories unchanged.
